amendments.note: Front-door seam 8: typed data-use declaration intake over data-use-admission 0.2.0. The write records what a declarer asserted and confers nothing (DE-1, FD-12.5); data_ref is an opaque handle and no field carries the data; the classification, purpose and residency labels stay uninterpreted; declared_by is presented and unproven. No egress restriction is expressible and none is invented. No other operation changed.
